entities.title: Inkwell Academy
entities.summary: An original school-day caper for the browser, made in Godot 4: follow the timetable, dodge lines, light the school's eight crests and ring the Founder's Bell.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the Godot project in godot/, the generators of its art and sound in tools/, the page's loader and headers in web/, the Worker that serves it behind the sign-in in worker/, and the Worker's tests in test/. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker.
boundaries: The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here.
There is no server-side state: the best score is kept in the player's browser.
